name: dot-bloom
title: Dot Bloom
description: Halftone dot transition. White dots spark over the outgoing shot while it washes out to cream, then the cream breaks into warm coral, peach and blush dots in drifting diagonal bands that thin out cell by cell until the incoming shot is all that is left. Every cell of every step is replayed from a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/transitions/dot-bloom?ref=cli — lay it over both shots and cut under it at DOT_BLOOM_CUT, where the cream covers the frame. — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
